cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: take a photo · /ˌteɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to use a camera to make a picture. Can you take a photo of us?
make a mistake · /ˌmeɪk ə mɪˈsteɪk/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to do or write something that is not correct. It is normal to make a mistake when learning.
take a seat · /ˌteɪk ə ˈsit/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to sit down; often used as a polite invitation. Please take a seat by the window.
take a shower · /ˌteɪk ə ˈʃaʊɚ/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to wash your body while standing under running water. I take a shower after swimming.
make friends · /ˌmeɪk ˈfrɛndz/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to start friendly relationships with other people. You can make friends at a new class.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.

articulation.label: make
articulation.alt: make: /m/ → /eɪ/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
